grounding.excerpt: *10     The limits begin on the effective date of this permit and lasting through 3 years from the permit effective date.
*11     The limits apply during the period beginning 3 year from the permit effective date
This permit shall become effective on December 1, 2021. This permit and the authorization to discharge shall expire at midnight, November 30, 2026.

payload.rationale: The obligation asks which single TDS net-increase limit regime governs all FY2025 monthly monitoring periods. The packet establishes two staged regimes: footnote *10 covers the period from the effective date (2021-12-01) through three years from that date, and footnote *11 covers the period beginning three years from the effective date (~2024-12-01) through expiration (2026-11-30). Federal FY2025 (2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30) straddles that boundary: October–November 2024 falls within the *10 window while December 2024–September 2025 falls within the *11 window. The excerpts therefore do not establish one regime-interval pairing for the entire period_universe. ACCEPT would require establishing a single applicable regime for FY2025 as a whole; REJECT would require establishing that no limit regime applies during FY2025, which the staged limits contradict. The packet also does not explicitly bind each numeric limit (27,664 vs 24,992 lbs/day) to *10 versus *11. Neither adjudication burden is met; UNRESOLVED is the correct disposition.
